scenes.label: Data-centre facilities verified in Kenya — 20 operational today; 31 tracked including 4 East Africa reference records
Running IT load published by Kenya's operational facilities — against 42.9 MW of live designed (built) capacity
Under-construction, committed and early-stage supply, as announced by developers — 272.9 MW total tracked, all stages
Networks connected across Kenya's 20 operational facilities, per PeeringDB — Africa Data Centres NBO1 alone hosts 122
Subsea cables in service at Kenyan landings, of 10 systems tracked — Africa-1 is landed, ready-for-service pending

sourcePolicy: Every statistic scene carries a named source and verification date, enforced in code (missing source renders a DO NOT PUBLISH flag). Figures are the canonical site-stats set: 27 verified Kenya facilities (20 operational), 10.5 MW published in-service IT load, 42.9 MW live designed capacity, 230 MW announced pipeline, 272.9 MW total tracked supply, 448 PeeringDB network connections across the 20 operational facilities (per-facility counts summed), 7 of 10 subsea cable systems in service. Dataset: DC254 directory 2026-Q3 (released 2026-09-19, facility records last verified Oct 2026); cable tracker last verified Sep 2026. No market-size, revenue, utilisation or job figures - those are not in the verified dataset. Backgrounds are real images from the DC254 repo, chosen to match each card's subject.
